pages.text: Want to know what's under a crone's skirt? HAHAHA! you'll need to get your own robe first! Granny's robe was sewn by Granny's apprentice! Not only is it itchy, but it also comes with a built-in brewing stand!
This robe further enhances your Fel spells! Wearing this dress—as beautiful as Granny's dentures—also lets your muddy little boys feel the touch of soul healing!

pages.title: Crone Hat
pages.text: If you really want to be part of the family, don't forget to wear a Crone Hat! It keeps your Fel servants from fading away like Vexes! What's that? You're asking where Granny got her hat? Borrow one from another Granny HAHAHA!
